falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the 'bottom' pattern match, as the August 2024 bottom was followed by a grind higher, not an immediate breakout to new highs; this would signal continuation rather than bottoming behavior

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained sub-12 VIX indicates complacency and risk-on stability, directly contradicting the elevated uncertainty and volatility typically present at genuine market bottoms; the August 2024 bottom saw VIX spike above 38

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further below -50 basis points
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion would signal worsening recession probability and credit stress, invalidating a 'bottom' call because bottoms form on expectations of recovery/steepening, not deteriorating forward economic conditions

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
